statement: The S&P 500 index will close at a fresh all-time high on at least one trading day between 2026-08-07 and 2026-08-14.
resolution: TRUE if S&P 500 (SPX) records an all-time-high closing price on any trading day between 2026-08-07 and 2026-08-14, per Yahoo Finance, WSJ, or Google Finance data; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: By 2026-08-17, no trading day between 2026-08-07 and 2026-08-14 shows an S&P 500 closing price above its prior all-time-high close.

statement: GDACS will upgrade its alert level for Tropical Cyclone CHAN-HOM-26 from Green to Orange or Red at some point between 2026-08-07 and 2026-08-14.
resolution: TRUE if GDACS (gdacs.org) shows an Orange or Red alert level for Tropical Cyclone CHAN-HOM-26 between 2026-08-07 and 2026-08-14; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: By 2026-08-17, GDACS shows Tropical Cyclone CHAN-HOM-26 remained at Green or was closed out without reaching Orange or Red.

statement: North Carolina Ports will publicly confirm the cyberattack disrupting its operations was ransomware, between 2026-08-08 and 2026-08-22.
resolution: TRUE if NC Ports or an FBI or CISA statement calls this incident ransomware, as reported by BleepingComputer or a wire service, between 2026-08-08 and 2026-08-22; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: By 2026-08-25, no official body has attached the ransomware label to the NC Ports incident described in item 17.

statement: Spain will move beyond its stated threat and implement reciprocal entry checks on travelers from Italy, between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-24.
resolution: TRUE if the Spanish Interior Ministry announces active reciprocal checks on Italy-origin travelers between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-24, confirmed by at least two of Al Jazeera, BBC, or DW; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: By 2026-08-27, Spain has not moved beyond its stated threat to active reciprocal checks on Italy-origin travelers.

statement: At least one of the 78 people arrested in the Spain-led Mediterranean smuggling-network raid will be formally charged, between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-28.
resolution: TRUE if Spanish judicial or Interior Ministry sources, or at least two of Al Jazeera, BBC, or Reuters, report formal charges against at least one raid detainee between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-28; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: By 2026-09-01, no formal charge against any of the 78 raid detainees has been publicly reported.

statement: Houthi forces will be reported to have captured or besieged a district-level administrative center in Marib or Hodeidah governorate, between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-28.
resolution: TRUE if at least two of Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, or the Yemeni government report Houthi capture or siege of a named district center between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-28; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: By 2026-09-01, no district-level Houthi capture or siege in Marib or Hodeidah has been reported by at least two sources.

statement: The ELN will be reported responsible for an attack killing at least one Colombian security-force member, between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-28.
resolution: TRUE if the Colombian Defense Ministry or at least two of Reuters, AP, or El Tiempo report an ELN-attributed killing of a security-force member between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-28; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: By 2026-09-01, no ELN-attributed fatal attack on Colombian security forces has been reported.

statement: BLS will report a second consecutive month of net job losses for August 2026, in the Employment Situation release published between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-12.
resolution: TRUE if the BLS Employment Situation report covering August 2026, released between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-12, shows negative net nonfarm payroll change; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: The BLS report covering August 2026 shows a zero or positive nonfarm payroll change, or is not released by 2026-09-15.

statement: The US Senate will vote to confirm Todd Blanche as Attorney General between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-11.
resolution: TRUE if the Senate confirms Blanche by roll-call vote between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-11, per congress.gov or at least two of NPR, CNBC, or Guardian; FALSE if rejected, withdrawn, or no vote occurs.
failure_condition: By 2026-09-15, the Senate has not confirmed Blanche, or has rejected the nomination, or it was withdrawn.

statement: The Russia sanctions bill the Senate passed on 2026-08-07 will be signed into law between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-25.
resolution: TRUE if congress.gov or the Federal Register shows this bill assigned a Public Law number with a signature date between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-25; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: By 2026-09-29, no Public Law number and presidential signature exists for the Senate-passed Russia sanctions bill.
